description: Fetch structured data for a single Amazon product by ASIN. Returns ~55 fields including title, price, variations, reviews, category ladder, images.

country.description: Optional 2-letter uppercase exit country (e.g. "US"). Defaults to the marketplace country; does not change the marketplace or currency.

language.description: Content language xx_YY (e.g. en_US, de_DE). Not all combos supported per marketplace.

name: amazon_product
